name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for an attached ADU project?
description: Before contacting a contractor, prepare your project goals, desired size and features, estimated budget, timeline, and any existing property documents.

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for an attached ADU project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting a contractor for an attached ADU project, it's helpful to have a clear understanding of your goals, such as whether it's for rental income or family use, and a general idea of your desired size and features. Gathering any existing property surveys, site plans, or previous renovation plans can also be valuable. Knowing your estimated budget range and preferred timeline will enable a more productive initial discussion with our team at Hometelligent.
